_note: Worcester dinner service. Layout points and seating zones come from layout/floor_plan.json; students reach the back seating room through one of its doors. close_min 1260 (9:00 pm) is sourced; open_min 990 (4:30 pm) is team-confirmed. expected_students 3000 and the peak windows (6:00-6:45, 7:00-8:00, 8:00-9:00 pm) come from team observation (2026-11-12); wave widths and shares are guesses. See ASSUMPTIONS.md. favorite_patience_mult 3.0: students wait up to 3x longer in a line for their first-choice dish (team: 'wait if I really want that dish'); 3x is a guess. retry_balked_favorite: a student who leaves their favorite's line eats elsewhere, then tries it once more (team, 2026-11-12). empty_pan_wait_min 2.0 (engine 0.5.0, IMPROVEMENTS 1.2): at the counter, a student whose dish is empty but already cooking waits up to 2 min (x favorite_patience_mult = 6 min for their first choice) instead of switching at once; a guess. seat_limits false (engine 0.5.0, IMPROVEMENTS 2.4): the layout's 284 + 120 seats are assumed (tables are not drawn) and the 7:30 pm peak wants 530-680 seats, so seats stay unlimited until someone counts them; every night reports peak_seated. Set true (with real seat counts in layout/floor_plan.json) to make students wait for a seat.

late_night._note: Late night 9:00 pm-12:00 am: the interval is sourced (umassdining.com Worcester page, audit fact F03); the days it runs are not (F03 conflict), so it is modeled on every date with a published late-night menu. expected_students 1000 and the taper (fewer than 30 students in the hall at 11:30 pm) are team guesses (2026-11-13). plate_size: late night is a snack, 1-2 items (team, 2026-11-13; shares are a guess). The arrival curve is tuned so fewer than 30 students are inside at 11:30 pm: arrivals peak 9:15 and 9:55 pm, few after 11 (about 20 inside at 11:30 on every date, engine 0.4.1). Serving stops at close_min; seated students may stay.
